published.citation: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, period relations for Galactic fundamental-mode Cepheids applied to this star's period, 15.627 d in Hoffmann et al. (2016), ApJ 830, 10, table 5; not a measurement of this star: the luminosity of eq. 1 (M_bol = -2.95 log P - 0.98, with the nominal solar M_bol 4.74) over the radius of eq. 2, through L = 4 pi R^2 sigma T^4 with the nominal solar 5772 K (IAU 2015 Resolutions B2 (Mamajek et al. 2015, arXiv:1510.06262) and B3 (Prsa et al. 2016, arXiv:1605.09788)); the uncertainty is the 317 K by which the two relations miss the paper's own temperatures of its Cepheids: 5170 +/- 317 K, https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: the star has no Gaia DR3 source; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
